issue.title: Retire artifacts_agents_pane
issue.description: The Artifacts tab shows a new 'Agent' pane immediately before Files, backed by the Textual-free agent catalog snapshot and the agents query profile.

task_type_fields.when_enabled: The Artifacts tab shows a new 'Agent' pane immediately before Files, backed by the Textual-free agent catalog snapshot and the agents query profile.

payload.entry: Flag removed and this bead retired by epic sase-tj's land agent. Phase sase-tj.9 (commit e5989fd28) deleted the Off branch, made the Agent pane unconditional in resolve_artifacts_subtabs(), and removed the FeatureFlag.artifacts_agents_pane member plus its FeatureFlagDefinition from src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py and the generated sase.schema.json block; verified no artifacts_agents_pane reference survives outside two plan-path comments. sase_flags.md requires the flag bead to close in that same change and it did not, leaving tools/check_feature_flags rule 8 emitting a live-bead-with-no-definition warning that hardens to an error once the landing grace lapses. Closing now to repair that.
